paragraphs: The operational firmware algorithm is represented by the flowchart in Figure 3.3. Upon system power-up, GPIO pins, I2C peripherals, and the LCD display are initialized. The main executive loop periodically triggers distance measurements every 500ms.

Acquired echo pulse durations are filtered through the 5-sample circular buffer. The resulting filtered distance is evaluated against the 15 cm overflow threshold and 30 cm warning threshold to determine system state and update audio-visual outputs.
